**What problem are you trying to solve?**

**What would you like the tool to do?** (inputs and output, read-only or editing)

**What can it not prove or risk getting wrong?** (be honest about limits)

**Anything that touches editing must keep the approval protocol** (propose, approve with code, backup, verify, rollback). Please say how your idea fits.
